ops.oldText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Customer may terminate this Agreement, or elect not to renew any renewal term, for any reason following the Initial Term upon thirty (30) days written notice to Kubient, and Kubient may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to Customer.

input.comment: [Playbook] We shortened our exit/non-renewal window on the automatic 1-year renewals to thirty (30) days, consistent with our playbook position that renewals must be easy to exit (sixty (60) days is our fallback); Kubient's ninety (90) day notice right is unchanged.
input.summary: Reduce Customer's non-renewal/termination notice window after the Initial Term from 90 to 30 days.
